anomalies.observed: On both M5-BUS connectors J1 and J2 the '+5V' net label is attached to pin 25 and the 'BAT' net label to pin 27, while pin 29 is left unconnected.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification, +5V must land on pin 27 (the M5Stack bus 5V pin) and the battery net /BAT on pin 29, i.e. +5V→27 and BAT→29.

evidence.quote: The same +5V net is also tied directly to J1/J2 pin 27 (the M5Stack bus's 5V pin)
onto the /BAT net, which is wired straight to pin 29 of the M5Stack bus connectors (J1/J2)
J1/J2 left-column labels read ... 'PIN23' (pin 23), '+5V' (pin 25), 'BAT' (pin 27), pin 29 unlabelled

anomalies.impact: The carrier would take its +5V feed from bus pin 25 (not the bus 5V pin 27) and would tie the LiPo battery onto bus pin 27 (which is the bus 5V pin), so the board's power architecture differs from the intended 'battery on BAT pin / 5V on 5V pin' arrangement and the intended 5V feed is not received.

parsed.summary: All component types and values match the specification, but the two M5Stack bus power nets appear to be on the wrong pins: the schematic wires +5V to J1/J2 pin 25 and BAT to pin 27, whereas the specification requires +5V on pin 27 and BAT on pin 29. Reported with moderate confidence because the pin-number reading is close to the labels.
